questions.question: What happens if you launch a distributed JAX script on a 4-host `v5litepod-16` slice without `--worker=all`?
options: Google Cloud automatically merges the 4 Linux hosts into 1 host
Only worker 0 starts Python, so `jax.distributed.initialize()` hangs waiting for the other 3 hosts (or 12 of the 16 TPU chips sit idle)
The script runs four times faster
questions.explanation: Every host in a multi-host TPU Pod slice runs its own OS and Python process; `--worker=all` is required so all hosts join the collective mesh.
